sentences.text:
The plea of the petitioner is that the land measuring 5 marlas of the petitioner can be acquired by the respondents in case they intend to do so only under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act,
2013.

sentences.text: Issue notice to the respondents in the main petition as well as in the interim application.

It is directed that the proceedings under the Jammu and Kashmir Land Acquisition Act, if any,
being pursued by the respondents shall not be proceeded till next date of hearing before the Bench.
Status quo with regard to writ property be also maintained.
(PUNEET GUPTA) JUDGE Jammu:
